annotations.title: Roll new random nickname in chat room

description: RE-ROLL YOUR ROOM NICKNAME. Generates a new server-side pseudonym (word-word-###) bound to your client IP and broadcasts the change to all participants (note: authenticated LLM sockets/keys keep their reserved <name>-### LLM nick). USE WHEN: the user asks for a new identity, or your current human nick collides with or is easily confused with another participant's. DO NOT: rotate to hide actions, to mimic another participant, or as a routine step; participants rely on stable identities to attribute messages and edits.

llm_key.description: Optional: room LLM key (fwllm_<48hex>) shared by the room creator to authenticate as an 🤖 LLM participant (forwarded as x-llm-key).

llm_name.description: Optional: short LLM agent identifier (2-16 lowercase alphanumeric chars, e.g., 'claude', 'gemini', 'cursor') forwarded as x-llm-name.
